ORDINANCE CXXIII OF 1996
EHTESAB (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to amend the Ehtesab
Ordinance, 1996
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 31st December, 1996]
F.No.2(I)/96‑Pub., dated 31‑12‑1996.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient to amend the
Ehtesab Ordinance, 1996 (CXI of 1996), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑‑(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Ehtesab (Amendment) Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 2, Ordinance CXI of 1996

ORDINANCE CXXIII OF 1996
EHTESAB (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to amend the Ehtesab
Ordinance, 1996
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 31st December, 1996]
F.No.2(I)/96‑Pub., dated 31‑12‑1996.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient to amend the
Ehtesab Ordinance, 1996 (CXI of 1996), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑‑
2. Amendment of section 2, Ordinance
CXI of 1996.‑‑In
the Ehtesab Ordinance, 1996 (CXI of 1996), in section 2, in clause (f),‑‑‑
(a) in sub‑clause (iv), after
the word "Province" the words "or of a local council constituted
under any Federal or Provincial law relating to the constitution of local
councils" shall be inserted; and
PLD
(b) after sub‑clause (iv),
amended as aforesaid, the following new sub clause shall be added, namely:
"(v) is or has been the
Chairman or Vice‑Chairman of a zila council, a municipal committee, a
municipal corporation or a metropolitan corporation constituted under any
Federal or Provincial law relating to local councils.
Explanation.‑‑For the
purpose of this sub‑clause the expression "Chairman" and
"Vice‑Chairman" shall respectively include the Mayor and the
Deputy Mayor.".
